title: Station state post
description: The body of POST /api/station/state, as the station sends it today (StationLink._state, sizeup/cloud/station.py). The latest post wins and nothing is queued: it is the station's heartbeat, who is talking now, the page going out now and, about every 5 s, its whole status. Plain JSON, never gzipped, with a Content-Length; the hub takes at most 4 MiB. Two variants: without `status` (sent at once when the talkers change, and every 2 s while someone talks) and with `status`.

at.description: The station's clock when it built this post, Unix seconds with a fraction. The hub keeps (its own clock - at) as this station's clock skew, in seconds; it stamps the snapshot with its own clock.

talking.description: Everyone transmitting now, and whoever just finished and was not shown live. The whole list every time ([] when nobody talks). The hub keeps the first 50 entries and drops the snapshot when it is older than 8 s. The hub reads `paging` only when `talking` is present.

paging.description: The two-tone pages going out now, newest first. The whole list every time ([] when none). The hub keeps the first 8 entries.

talker.title: One talker
talker.description: One radio transmitting now, on a P25 talkgroup or an analog FM channel (sizeup/radio/live.py).

key.description: Stable id of this entry while it lasts: `p25:<system name>:<call key>:<radio id>` or `fm:<channel>:<since, 2 decimals>:<radio id>`. Opaque to the hub.

system.description: The kind of radio system. The hub looks the radio up in its own registry under P25 unless this is `fm`.

channel.description: The talkgroup's name (P25) or the channel's label (FM).

tg.description: The P25 talkgroup number; null on an FM channel.

radio_id.description: The transmitting radio's id as decoded (P25 unit id, MDC-1200 or FleetSync id), digits as a string; "" when not known yet.

alias.description: The radio's over-the-air alias (P25); "" when none.

rig.description: The unit the station's registry gives this radio; "" when unknown. The hub replaces it from its own registry whenever `radio_id` is set.

label.description: The registry's label for the radio; replaced on the hub like `rig`.

since.description: When the call or the carrier started, Unix seconds.

talk_since.description: When this radio started talking within the call, Unix seconds.

ended.description: True for a talker who just finished and is flashed until `until`.

until.description: Unix seconds until which an ended entry is still shown; null while talking.

dispatcher.description: The alias looks like a dispatch console.

main.description: The talkgroup is one of the main ones (always true on FM).

id_on_release.description: FM entries only: the carrier is open and no id was decoded yet (these radios send it when the key is released).

page.title: One page going out
page.description: A two-tone page as it is decoded, pair by pair (sizeup/radio/livepage.py). The hub drops an entry without a `pairs` list.

started.description: When the first tone started, Unix seconds.

pairs.description: The tone pairs decoded so far, in order.

items.title: One tone pair
items.description: One A/B tone pair of the page.

names.description: Who this pair pages, by name; [] for a pair the station does not know.

ours.description: The pair pages one of this department's own.

phase.description: `tones` while pairs are still coming, `voice` once the dispatcher speaks.

ended.description: The page is over; shown until `until`.

until.description: Unix seconds until which an ended page is still shown; null while it goes out.

page_id.description: The id of the finished page this became; "" until then.

status.title: Station status
status.description: Everything else the station reports, about every 5 s and right after it ran a job (StationLink.status). The hub keeps the whole object as the station's latest status, replaces `id` with the authenticated id and takes `talkgroups` out into its own list. Objects marked x-complete list every key the station sends; the others belong to the module named in their description and list the keys that are always there or that the hub reads.

id.description: The station id this post claims: the config's until the hub's answer names another (`station`). It must be the id the bearer token proves, else 401 `id_mismatch`. At most 64 printable characters; a station with its own token has `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,39}`.

config_id.description: `[station] id` from the station's config file. The hub uses it to forget a renamed station's former ids once the config has caught up.

radios.description: One row per receiver and service, in order: each FM / AM channel, the county P25 system, each other P25 system, speech-to-text (`STT`), the dispatch voice (`Voice`). The station's own `Hub` row is left out.

items.title: One radio row
items.description: A receiver's or service's state (sizeup/radio/fm.py, am.py, p25.py, systems.py, sizeup/tts.py; App.radio_status). FM rows add the squelch's numbers, AM rows their frequencies; only the common keys are listed.

label.description: The row's name: a channel's label, a P25 system's, `STT` or `Voice`.

mhz.description: The channel's frequency, MHz; null for a row that is not one frequency.

detail.description: A sentence for people about the state.

restarts.description: How many times the receiver's program was restarted since the station started.

last_heard.description: When it last received something, Unix seconds; null for never.

quieting_db.description: FM: how far the noise is quieted now, dB; null when not measured.

word.description: A short word shown in place of the state (e.g. `RX hold`, `no audio`), when there is one.

open_s.description: FM / AM: how long the squelch has been open without a break, seconds; null when closed.

stuck.description: FM / AM: open for longer than a transmission can be.

open_db.description: FM / AM: the squelch opens at this much quieting, dB.

close_db.description: FM / AM: the squelch closes below this much quieting, dB.

hiss_db.description: FM / AM: the idle hiss the quieting is measured from, relative dB; null until measured.

floor_db.description: FM / AM: the channel's noise floor, relative dB; null until measured.

min_open_s.description: FM noise squelch only: the shortest opening kept, seconds.

short_per_min.description: FM noise squelch only: openings shorter than `min_open_s`, per minute.

squelch_default.description: FM noise squelch only: the receiver's own defaults {open_db (dB), close_db (dB), min_open_s (s)}.

channel_kind.description: FM noise squelch only: the channel's kind from the config (`paging`, `traffic`, ...); "" when unknown.

keyups.description: FM traffic channels only: counts of recent key-ups with no speech (App.keyups).

system.description: Rows of the other P25 systems only: the system's name.

hold_until.description: Rows of the other P25 systems only: held back after dropouts until this time, Unix seconds.

sdr.description: The shared dongles and what each is set to (App.sdr): `shared`, `mode`, `modes`, `now`, `switching`, `adsb`, `duplicates`, `sdrs` (one row per dongle), `groups`, `no_park`, `groups_problem`. null when every channel has a dongle of its own.

rerun.title: Re-run progress
rerun.description: The re-transcription the hub asked for, as counts of clips.

total.description: Clips asked for in this run.

changed.description: Of those, how many got another text.

pending.description: Clips still waiting, the catch-up's left out.

channels.title: Channel choices applied
channels.description: The per-channel choices the hub sent, as this station runs them (App.channels_applied). The hub compares `sig` with its own and sends the choices again when they differ.

prefs.description: Per channel key, the choices in force (speech-to-text engine, transcribe on or off, ...); {} for none.

aws.description: What the hub last said about Amazon Transcribe: `ok` (boolean), `why` (text), `reserve` (channel keys), and `deny` when the hub sent one.

tones.description: How many tone-code choices are in force (a count, not the list).

squelch.description: Per FM channel label, the squelch numbers the hub set; {} for none.

squelch_ok.description: This station takes squelch settings from the hub. An implicit capability flag: the hub sends them only when it is true.

deny_ok.description: This station takes `aws.deny` from the hub. An implicit capability flag, like `squelch_ok`.

sig.description: A short hex digest of everything above (sizeup/channels.py sig), compared for equality only.

p25_systems.description: The other P25 systems this station runs, one object each (sizeup/radio/systems.py state): `name`, `label`, `title`, `site`, `jobs`, `frequencies`, `covered`, `state`, `detail`, `last_heard`, `cc`, `unknown`, `encrypted`, `watched`. [] when none. The key's presence is an implicit capability flag: the hub treats a status without it as a station from before the other systems.

reception.description: The reception test's numbers and history (sizeup/radio/reception.py state). The hub reads `history[]`: `id`, `restored`, `ended`.

stt_terms.title: Term lists applied
stt_terms.description: The versions of the private term lists the hub sent for whisper's prompt (never the terms). The hub sends the lists again when `v` differs from its own.

v.description: The version of the lists in force; "" for none.

sets.description: Per list name, its own version; present once the hub has sent any.

outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.description: The durable queue of events waiting to go up (sizeup/cloud/outbox.py).

oldest.description: When the oldest waiting event was queued, Unix seconds; null when none waits.

dropped_audio.description: Clips whose audio was dropped to keep the outbox under its size limit (the events stayed).

stt_input.title: Speech-to-text inputs
stt_input.description: The lane that sends each clip's exact speech-to-text input to the hub (sizeup/cloud/sttinput.py; StationLink.stt_stats). Counts are since the station started.

waiting.description: Encoded inputs waiting to go up.

dropped.description: Inputs dropped, by reason: `queue`, `too_big`, `failed` (the encoder's), `outbox` (over its budget), `refused` (by the hub, for good). Each a count.

dropped_pre.description: Of the dropped, those of pre-alert channels.

dropped_fire.description: Of the dropped, those of fire channels.

encoder.description: Where inputs are encoded: "" before the first, else `scope`, `process` or `thread (<why>)`.

held.description: Lower-priority inputs are held now because whisper is behind on live traffic.

detail.description: What was last said about it.

unhealthy.description: The worker is alive but not answering in time.

in_flight.description: An input is being encoded now.

pool_worker.title: Whisper as a pool worker
pool_worker.description: This station's whisper as one of the hub's speech-to-text pool workers (sizeup/cloud/stationworker.py). Counts are since the station started.

preempted.description: Jobs aborted for one of the station's own clips.

why.description: Why it is off or paused; "" when online.

stt_alert_rev.description: The revision of the pre-alert source list this station has: a content hash of the set as an integer below 2^53 (sizeup/intel/engine.py push_rev), 0 until the hub has sent one. The hub sends its list again when the number differs from its own. The key's presence is an implicit capability flag: a station without it is never sent the list.

version.title: Version and update
version.description: The build this station runs, the hub's build as it last heard it, and the updater's state (sizeup/cloud/autoupdate.py Watch.status; StationLink.version).

build.description: The git sha this station runs; "" when unknown (a development checkout).

hub.description: The hub's build as its state answers gave it (7 to 40 lower-case hex); "" when not heard or not a sha.

update.description: The updater's own state file, cut to `state`, `since`, `to`, `from`, `paused`, `windows`, `last`, `equivalent`, `retry`, `hold` (each only when the file has it) and `failed` (the newest five failures by sha, always there).

failed.description: Per target sha, why the update to it failed; {} for none.

adapter.title: Incident-source adapter
adapter.description: The private incident-source adapter this release runs. Names and states only: never a credential, a URL or a value read from the source.

repo.description: The adapter repository's short name; "" when off.

commit.description: The installed commit, at most 12 hex characters; "" when none.

health.description: Each incident source's own health, as its runner last reported it.

state.description: `starting` before the first report, then the runner's word (`ok`, `backing_off`, `failing`, ...).

logship.description: The journal shipper's state and counters (sizeup/cloud/logship.py stats): `state`, `reason`, `level`, `on`, the spool's size and the lines sent and dropped by reason. When reading them fails: {state: `error`, reason: <the error's type name>}.

state.description: The shipper's state in a word.

metrics.title: Signal-metrics link
metrics.description: The signal-metrics sender's counters (sizeup/cloud/metrics.py). No reader of this object was found on the hub.

dropped.description: Records dropped (the memory buffer was full).

last_ok.description: When the hub last took a batch, Unix seconds; null for never.

health.description: The machine and its radio programs (sizeup/cloud/health.py station_metrics). The machine's numbers: `started` and `boot` (Unix seconds), `host`, `cpu_pct` (0 to 100 or null), `load1`, `cpus`, `mem_pct`, `mem_total` (bytes), `temp_c`, `disk_path`, `disk_pct`, `disk_free` and `disk_total` (bytes); then, each only when it applies, `recorder`, `whisper`, `stt_queue`, `jobs`, `reception`, `usb`, `heard`, `adsb`. When building it fails: {error: `<Type>: <message>`, at most 200 characters}.

talkgroups.description: Every known or heard P25 talkgroup with its switches (sizeup/talkgroups.py state). Sent only when a row's (tg, record, main, system, tier) changed, or every 30 s; when absent the hub keeps the list it has. [] for a station without P25.

items.title: One talkgroup
items.description: One talkgroup row. It also carries `name`, `group`, `encrypted`, `count`, `last`, `dropped`, `source`, `key`, `ours`, `service`, `service_auto`, `department`.

main.description: It is one of the main talkgroups.

tier.description: Another system's talkgroup: its tier; null for the county system's own switches. The hub adds `tier_set` (tier is not null) when the row has none.
